This follows actual documented gaps, not a blanket refusal to research: Boston lacks adopted breakfast/recent-review proof; Chicago has unresolved one-adult applicability and a maintenance complaint; Denver and Phoenix adopted cards lack recent topic evidence; Seattle still needs one-adult/provider matching and a noise review.
